Frequently Asked Questions

Does Spectrum have 24/7 customer service?

To set up new Spectrum services, including Spectrum Internet, cable TV or Home Phone plan, call Spectrum Customer Service at 855.860.9068, Monday-Sunday, 7AM-2AM ET.

If you have account and billing questions, contact customer service 24/7 at 833.949.0036

For 24/7 technical support and online assistance with your account, please visit Spectrum Customer Support.

If you have questions about Spectrum Mobile, visit Spectrum Mobile Customer Support.

Can I pay my Spectrum bill by phone?
To pay your Spectrum bill over the phone or online, visit Pay My Bill for complete details. You can also pay your Spectrum bill on your mobile device using the My Spectrum App.
How do I find Spectrum outage information?
If your Spectrum Internet, cable TV or Home Phone service is not working, find out if a service outage has occurred in your area by visiting the Outage Information and Troubleshooting page.
How do I contact Spectrum Internet Customer Service?
Spectrum Internet Customer Service is available 24/7 by calling 888.369.2408. You can also find solutions to common Internet issues on the Spectrum Internet Customer Support page.

https://www.spectrum.com/choose-spectrum.raw_html:
INTERNET + MOBILE

Save $1,000 with the Spectrum Savings Guarantee

Start your switch

HOW IT WORKS

Save when you switch or we'll credit the rest

Switch Internet and 2+ Mobile lines - no matter how much you save with Spectrum compared to your previous provider, we'll credit the difference monthly over the first year.

Claim your savings in three steps

Choose qualifying services

Add a qualifying Spectrum Internet® plan and switch two or more mobile lines from Verizon, AT&T or T-Mobile.

Submit your previous bills

Send us copies of your previous provider bills within 60 days of installation and we'll review.

Receive your savings

If you don't save $1,000 in your first year, we'll cover the difference in equal monthly bill credits.

Get started

Why switch to Spectrum?

You'll enjoy guaranteed savings and so much more.

No contracts and no data caps

Same or next-day install

Runs on America's most reliable 5G network

Multi-year price guarantee

Start your switch

Let's get you connected

See available plans in your area.
Check availability

Frequently asked questions

What is the Spectrum Savings Guarantee?
The Spectrum Savings Guarantee ensures you save at least $1,000 in your first year when you switch both your Internet and Mobile services to Spectrum. If your total savings do not reach $1,000, we'll cover the difference with credits over the first year.
How do I qualify?

To qualify for the Spectrum Savings Guarantee, you must:

  • Be a Spectrum Internet customer or become a Spectrum Internet customer by adding Spectrum Internet Advantage, Premier, Gig or Multi-Gig plans.
  • Add the same number of paid Mobile lines as shown on your previous provider’s bill (minimum of two paid Mobile lines required).
  • Switch your mobile service from Verizon, T-Mobile or AT&T

New customers must switch from a competitor Internet provider to qualify (excludes subsidized services, dial-up, Lifeline programs and employee discounts). Both Internet and Mobile services must remain active for 12 months to receive the full savings.

How do I redeem my savings?
  1. Have or switch to Spectrum Internet and add two or more paid Unlimited Mobile lines.
  2. Complete the Spectrum Savings Guarantee form and upload copies of your most recent Internet and mobile bills.
  3. We'll calculate if you’ll save $1,000 in your first year with Spectrum and send you an email regarding your status. If we calculate your savings as less than $1,000, we’ll apply the difference to your bill in equal monthly credits over your first year.

Your Internet and Mobile pricing, and your credits, will not change as long as you maintain qualifying services for one year.

How are savings calculated and applied?

Savings are calculated by comparing your previous Internet and Mobile monthly costs with the cost of your qualifying Spectrum services during your first 12 months. One-time installation and activation charges are not included.

If your total savings are less than $1,000, Spectrum will apply equal monthly credits to your bill until you reach $1,000 in total savings.

How long does eligibility verification take?
You have 60 days from your initial Internet and Mobile order to submit a claim. Submissions are reviewed within 30 days. We may request additional information if needed.
Do I need to keep my services for a full year?
Yes. Both Spectrum Internet and Spectrum Mobile services must remain active for 12 months to receive the full savings. Remaining credits are forfeited if qualifying services are canceled early.
Can I combine this with other Spectrum promotions?
Yes. The Spectrum Savings Guarantee can be combined with other offers unless otherwise stated.
DC-565,DC-553
